correctness.rationale: For a given induced F, abstract prime extensions split exhaustively into joining any represented equivalence class or starting a new one. Induction on finite threshold t proves that every selected class must have at least t unselected points and the disjoint classes must dominate staircase (t,t-1,...,1); the inverse step explicitly selects an unused point in the appropriate class. This yields the exact finite rank, triangular minimum order and unique extremal size partition. A standalone literal-game engine, not the same recurrence, matched the formula for every subset of all 5296 labelled set partitions of orders 0 through 8 (1187043 positions). Finite checks corroborate, not replace, the induction.

value.rationale: The 2026 rank theory asks for concrete behavior across Fraïssé classes. Finite equivalence relations are a canonical class without free amalgamation; their rank depends on the full class-size partition rather than cardinality alone. The exact local rank criterion gives a nontrivial simultaneous capacity certificate for every substructure, sharp triangular minimal size, an extremizer uniquely determined up to isomorphism, and its exact labelled count. This fills a motivated exact finite case without claiming results for infinite structures.
